name: Draper Law Office

offices.label: Draper Law Office
offices.address: 705 W Emmett St, Kissimmee, FL 34741, USA

about: Draper Law Office is a personal injury firm with offices in Kissimmee and St Cloud.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 2 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G3.evidence: No matching active entity in the Florida corporate register. Florida does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to register, so this is a check we could not complete from this source rather than evidence against the firm
G3.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations, partial
G3.unresolvable: Florida does not require every law firm to register, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 10 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 143 public client reviews across 2 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2002-11-29, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

logo.source: The icon the firm's own site declares, copied here rather than hot-linked

bar_associations.name: New York State Trial Lawyers Association
bar_associations.quote: He is a member of the Florida Academy of Trial Lawyers and New York State Trial Lawyers Association. He earned his B.A. degree from Rollins College

accountability.evidence: member of New York State Trial Lawyers Association · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar B (0/15).

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 19.0 → 66th pct of 92-firm cohort (median 12) 2/3 · 1,013 referring domains, 38th pct 1/2 · 105 organic keywords / 343 visits·mo, 66th pct 1/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 2 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
